name: Arden Vale
description: A newly appointed circuit runner in a blue weather cape, with a salt-marked satchel, a clean route book, and the attentive posture of someone learning a public trust.

body.distinguishing: a faded rope burn across the left palm

personality: Patient, practical, and willing to ask a specialist before turning confidence into action. Arden takes public promises seriously and keeps careful notes.
knownLore: The circuit badge authorizes Arden to carry notices and sign public handoffs, while local specialists remain the authority on their own work.
backstory: Arden earned an appointment after a season assisting local couriers. The First Circuit is the first route for which their signature will become part of the islands' common record.
